response.title: Qualify current slot compiler layout, accessors, constants, interning, and digests
response.description: Qualify each current Slot compiler family at the compiler/IR boundary: slot layout, accessor lowering, constants, symbol interning, and workflow digests. Reuse historical implementation owners and do not infer missing behavior from closed status.
response.acceptance_criteria: [{"kind":"phase_specific_qualification","clauses":["Positive: bind source-visible slot declarations and references to exact stable slot layout and valid accessor/constant/symbol/digest outputs on representative current compiler inputs.","Negative: bind out-of-range or unsupported slot/accessor references, invalid constant references, symbol-table boundary violations, and digest mismatch cases to exact typed rejection or deterministic mismatch behavior where the current contract specifies them.","Keep slot layout, accessor tables, constant tables, symbol interning, and digest/parity evidence as separate ledger families; distinguish compile/parse parity from each family’s direct invariant checks.","For every family, name production entry points and exact registered checks/properties; record source pin and raw receipts with separate CODE and independent TEST dispositions, leaving unexecuted proof/fuzz/benchmark obligations unknown."]},{"kind":"per_clause_family_allocation","clauses":[{"family":"slot layout and source-slot reservation","existing_owner_ids":["vb-ito"],"allocation":"Reuse closed vb-ito as historical implementation owner; qualify layout and source-visible reservation independently."},{"family":"accessor lowering/table behavior","existing_owner_ids":["vb-mc8","vb-rs5","vb-ito"],"allocation":"Reuse closed vb-mc8/vb-rs5 implementation records and vb-ito phase contract; keep accessor qualification separate from slot/constant checks."},{"family":"constant table and constant references","existing_owner_ids":["vb-ito"],"allocation":"Reuse vb-ito historical ownership; map valid and invalid constant index/value behavior without proposing implementation work absent a reproduced defect."},{"family":"symbol interning and workflow digests","existing_owner_ids":["vb-ito"],"allocation":"Reuse vb-ito historical ownership; separately map interning stability and digest identity/parity checks."}]}]

dependencies.description: Scope: active Rust compiler, expression, core interpreter, storage, recovery/replay, direct API and binary IPC in velvet-ballistics-MASTER.md sections 10, 15, 18-21, 24-31, 35-36, 44-45 and 77. Baseline main 716ff3164b453d3cf56c10b31e572970ca7ed932. First reconcile every primitive and acceptance requirement with current production paths, registered executable checks, and existing beads; preserve existing issue ownership and reuse coverage rather than duplicating implementations. Then create bounded child contracts with explicit dependencies and rejection tests. Delivery per child: Rust contract, implementation in unique Git/JJ workspace, behavioral tests, independent CODE review and independent TEST review. Final acceptance requires source-to-IR-to-runtime/persist/reopen/replay parity over every active primitive, typed boundary failures, bounded resources, both direct and IPC routes, canonical moon ci and master-mandated evidence. No completion based on API existence, focused tests alone or stale closed issues. Removed codegen/UI excluded per master. Existing coordination checkout and all user changes protected. No commits/pushes requested.

Requirement ownership: master44 naming/identity/numeric/IR constraints and banned constructs -> vb-eirmk.11 and current mechanical gates; primitives/source/nesting -> vb-eirmk.3/.4 children, vb-rihha.1; expression parity -> .2/.5/.6; full replay -> .7/.8/.9; bounded admission/resources -> vb-rihha.3/.4/.5, vb-8vknz, vb-kg5dg; durability/schema/envelopes -> vb-qbub0/vb-b09dm/vb-peksc/vb-ma41g; public recovery -> vb-h5j05/vb-d9ywf/vb-8eocj.9.3.3 and .4; cancellation/shutdown/migration -> vb-qfka3/vb-64mha/vb-89j5n; retry/action authority -> vb-sfhyj/vb-0jns7; manual gate decisions -> existing vb-ifn5b; direct/IPC/CLI integration -> vb-eirmk.10 and existing vb-rihha.7.46/.7.81; current formal/fuzz/benchmark evidence -> vb-god2f/vb-awwnz/vb-rihha.6 and vb-eirmk.11. Existing epic trackers are tracks edges because Beads forbids a task depending on an epic; closure contract still requires all current-scope children accepted.
